notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.0.0.7 on Apr. 23, 2025)
notes.content:
[b]Additional Features and Adjustments[/b]
• Added Photo Mode. To start it, open the menu on the World Map or in battle and press the TouchPad button.
• Added Lion Dragon Armor as an outfit for the protagonist. You can try it on by selecting Change Outfit at your current base.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
• Fixed an issue causing graphical distortion when AMD FSR3 is enabled on Steam Deck.
• Fixed minor bugs.
Note: Controller buttons have been labeled according to PS5 console standards.

notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.0.0.6 on Mar. 19, 2025)
notes.content:
Additional Features and Adjustments
• Added Arabic as a text language option.
• Adjusted the staff weapon. The continuous attack executed by holding the Strong Attack button has been made more potent and the "Furious Tiger Dance" Battle Art has been given an effect that staggers enemies.
• Added a Skill Points trading feature. After completing the game, you can trade them for Portable Items and gold at the Shui Jing Retreat.

Bug Fixes
• Fixed an exploit allowing high walls and cliffs to be scaled by repeatedly attacking in midair.
• Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.0.0.5 on Feb. 21, 2025)
notes.content:
Additional Features and Adjustments
• The Gold Serpent Spear has been added to the game. After obtaining a weapon of the Lance type, a letter will arrive at your current base.
• Solved an issue that caused text rendered at high resolutions to appear less clear than it should.
• Added Rumor Settings to the Configuration menu. These new settings allow you to make the rumors that play automatically when on the World Map occur less frequently or make them play without sound.
• Added Frame Skip to the Graphics Settings menu. Turning it off when using VRR may make graphics smoother.
• Shortened the length of time that enemies are invulnerable during the animations that play out when they enter Rage mode.
• Added a feature that allows events to be paused by pressing the TouchPad button and allows UI elements to be hidden.
• Adjusted controller vibration for the Steam/Xbox Series X|S versions so that when Vibration Settings are set to Full Experience, more areas of the controller vibrate during actions like attacking and charging.

Bug Fixes
• Fixed a bug that caused officers to be highlighted as though the Highlight Officers setting in the Display menu had been set to the default even when the feature was turned off.
• Fixed a bug that was causing the portable item Incense of Vitality to not always heal allies properly when used.
• Fixed a bug that disabled the upgrade boost for the Adamantine Flesh Battle Art (Crescent Blade) after mastering it.
• Fixed a bug that caused the strength of Crescent Blade Battle Art Azure Dragon Bellow to not increase in line with its upgrade level.
• Fixed a bug that caused unintended damage when certain Battle Arts were canceled with Battle Arts with Sp. effects.
• Fixed other minor bugs.

Note: Controller buttons have been labeled according to PS5 console standards.

notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.0.0.4 on Feb. 6, 2025)
notes.content:
Additional Features and Adjustments
• Added error codes for the Steam version to specify the cause when the game fails to save data.

Bug Fixes
• Fixed a bug in the Steam version that caused an officer who should become a companion for the final battle of Liu Bei's route to be unavailable.
• Fixed a bug that was causing the game to crash under certain conditions.
• Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.0.0.3 on Jan. 20, 2025)
notes.content:
Additional Features and Adjustments
• Added Call Horse Response Time to control settings.
Default: Your horse will be called the instant you press the Call Horse button.
Hold: Your horse will be called when you hold down the Call Horse button for a certain amount of time.
• Made it possible for the Call Horse function to be set to the touchpad buttons.
• Made adjustments so that when the Call Horse function is set to either the down button or touchpad buttons and lock-on is set to R3, pressing L3 + R3 will still activate Rage.
• Display Settings: Added the Helpful option to the Highlight Officers settings.
The Helpful option improves visibility for the player on the battlefield.
• Made adjustments so that pressing the confirm button during the cutscene after a defeat will instantly bring up the restart menu.
• Controls Settings: Increased max camera rotation speed from 99 to 199.

Bug Fixes
• Fixed other minor bugs.

Note: Controller buttons have been labeled according to PS5 console standards.

notes.title: Release Version Update (Ver. 1.0.0.2 on Jan. 14, 2025)
notes.content:
We have made some adjustments to the keyboard and mouse controls based on feedback from users who played the demo.

Additional Features and Adjustments
• Made it possible for the TAB and back quote (`) keys to be set as key configurations.
• Made it possible for the side mouse buttons to be set as control buttons.

notes.title: Demo Version Update (Ver. 1.0.0.1 on Dec. 13, 2024)
notes.content:
Additional Features and Adjustments
• Made adjustments so that the controller used for the first button input upon launching the game will be set as the game controller.
• Adjusted the default key assignments for keyboard/mouse controls.
• Made it possible for the left, middle, and right mouse buttons to be set as key configurations.
• Resolved the issue causing key configurations to be reset on the title menu.
• Made it possible to remove keyboard controls for actions that were assigned mouse controls.
• Took measures to deal with the issue causing the key guide to switch between the keyboard/mouse display and controller display when using keyboard/mouse controls.

Bug Fixes
• Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Settings for the Demo Version (Nov. 22, 2024)
notes.content:
[h3]- Keyboard/Mouse Settings[/h3]
Specific keys can be assigned to different actions by following the steps below.

1. Select "Depart for Battle" to start, and once the war council has ended, select "Menu" (Esc) on the Battle Preparation screen.
2. Select "Keyboard/Mouse Controls" under "Controls" on the System tab.
3. Select "Action" and then change the keys assigned to each action.
4. When you return to the previous screen (Backspace), click "Yes" on the dialogue box asking if you would like to apply settings.

These settings can be set via both "Advanced Settings" on startup and "Menu" (Esc) on the pause screen during battle.

[h3]- Pauses during Battle[/h3]
There are three types of pauses during battle that can be set by following the steps below.

1. Select "Depart for Battle" to start, and once the war council has ended, select "Menu" (Esc) on the Battle Preparation screen.
2. Select "Battle Assistance" under "Configuration" on the System tab.
3. Select one of the three types: Helpful, Simplified, or None.

The three types
- Helpful: The battle is paused to display various types of information.
- Simplified: The battle is paused to display only important information.
- None: The battle is never paused when displaying information.

These settings can be set via either "Advanced Settings" on startup or "Menu" (Esc) on the pause screen during battle.

Players will play as a warrior who has lost his memories and must navigate the chaos of the era, from the "Yellow Turban Rebellion" to the "Battle of Chibi". Experience the realistic battlefields with massive numbers of soldiers and lead your allies to victory as you battle as 1 vs. 1,000.
